title: The Crane and the Long Wooden Bridge
synopsis: A flatbed delivers a wooden footbridge deck and a crane truck lifts it onto checked supports while the friends watch.
continuity_state: Before: Footings have been allowed time and checked, but there is no bridge deck. After: A prebuilt wooden walking deck is installed and fastened on the concrete supports. Rails, approach paths, and final checks are still pending; no one has crossed as a visitor.
